  "explanation": <one sentence>}

Case: Patient D is a 50-year-old Hispanic man presenting with severe left posterior thigh pain. Patient D states that he has had discomfort in his left thigh for several weeks, but this progressed into frank pain two days ago. On physical examination, you discover that he has diminished sensation in several dermatomes spanning his left leg. You obtain an MRI of the lumbosacral spine and discover a large parasacral mass extending toward his pelvic floor.
